career_ladder.note: Civilian Chargeman in the Indian Navy is a technical supervisory post under the Directorate of Civilian Personnel, Naval Headquarters. Chargeman commences as Group 'B' (Non-Gazetted) in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 and advances through technical supervisory and managerial roles up to General Manager level in Naval Dockyards and Armament Depots.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Civilian Chargeman in the Indian Navy is conducted through the Indian Navy Civilian Entrance Test (INCET). The examination is a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks of 90 minutes duration across four equal sections: General Intelligence and Reasoning (25), General Awareness (25), Quantitative Aptitude (25), and English Language (25). There is no negative marking. Candidates qualifying the CBT are called for Document Verification and Pre-Appointment Medical Examination.

financial_package.note: Civilian Chargeman in the Indian Navy is placed in 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 (entry basic ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400). Civilian staff deployed across Naval Dockyards, Armament Depots, and Missile Checkout facilities receive standard Central Government allowances, HRA, Transport Allowance, and CSD canteen privileges.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Indian Navy INCET-01/2023 Notification — Remuneration & Pay Scale for Chargeman
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹35,400 + 58% DA (₹20,532) + HRA (10%-30% by port city / location: ₹3,540 to ₹10,620) + Transport Allowance (₹2,844 to ₹5,688) yields gross ~₹62,000 to ~₹76,000. In-hand reflects ~10% NPS deduction and standard deductions.
official_perks: Government-funded residential quarters in Naval civilian housing colonies or applicable central HRA
Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) or Naval Hospital medical facilities
CSD Canteen smart card privileges across Naval bases and establishments
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance (CEA)
Overtime / industrial allowance entitlement where applicable in Naval Dockyards
